title: Counterfactual Invariance to Spurious Correlations: Why and How to Pass Stress Tests
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical formalization of counterfactual invariance and causal inference to address spurious correlations in machine learning. While it draws connections to algorithmic fairness (demographic parity and equalized odds) as part of its theoretical framework, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
